title: Set up HTML canvas, game loop, and pixel-art rendering engine
description: Create the single HTML file with embedded CSS/JS. Set up a 800x400 canvas with a pixel-art dark theme. Implement the core game loop (requestAnimationFrame), camera/viewport scrolling system, and a pixel-art sprite rendering utility that draws characters and objects using small filled rectangles. Include grid-based coordinate system with a 16px base tile size.
